failure_modes: gross asset value mistaken for shareholder value

remote options treated as contracted cash

Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.

method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.

outcomes.weighting_rule: Do not change a persona's relevance within a power zone until at least 20 attributable, dividend-aware outcomes exist there; never reweight automatically.

top_claims.claim: Detractor – Burford Capital (“BUR”): Pioneer & Leader of Litigation Finance Last October, LRN was the first stock of my 20-year career to drop ~50% in one day.

Burford is a litigation finance platform with a diversified case portfolio, proprietary underwriting data, and lumpy but historically strong cash generation. The YPF judgment reversal created a massive first-quarter 2026 mark-to-model loss and cut book value per share from $11.18 to $3.78, but liquidity remains solid a
We expect **17.56%** per year over 7 years at **~$4.31** on **$0.38/sh** starting owner cash.
*Primary risk: Leverage (3.5 times net tangible equity) meets lumpy legal outcomes; a string of adverse marks or slow realizations forces dilutive equity or distressed de-leveraging.
